g.text: Decision D1 · Is the fleetd design 1 deployable, or do the daemon or the fleet-run wrapper ship as their own binaries?
decision-organise-D1 · generated from organise.json · confidence high

svg.text: Rationale: The design settles it: fleetd is a subcommand of the single horch binary, so the CLI and the daemon cannot have different versions (design: Amendments D9, Migration plan, FM-34). The manifest target is 1 to 1.
Would flip if: The operator changes D9 and accepts a daemon that updates apart from the CLI
Would flip if: fleetd must run on a different machine from the CLI
Would flip if: A second team takes a context and needs its own release train

g.text: 1 modular monolith: the horch binary holds all 6
contexts; fleetd, the CLI commands, the wrapper and
fleetd check are process roles of it.
+ The CLI and the daemon cannot have different versions
+ horch self-update replaces 1 release asset and restarts the
+ Matches connect: all 13 relationships are in-process
− 1 team carries 6 contexts in 1 codebase; the load is high
− A fault in any module can stop the 1 daemon process
! Modules reach into each other's tables and the context
decision D1 option A, derived from the organise teams and deployables
